title: 16″ Dopezilla Hydra Water Pipe – Black
description:
Description
The Hydra by Dopezilla is handcrafted from the finest borosilicate glass that is able to withstand the test of time, all delivered, safely stored, in their own matching custom box.
Part of this fun collection is Hydra, a clear straight tube ice bong with a colored accent on the bowl, base, percolator, mouthpiece and custom monster logo is extremely easy to clean and maintain. The tree percolator makes the hit incredibly smooth. It features a removable slitted inside-cut 18mm > 14mm downstem for added diffusion and easy removable cleaning and ice notches, for optimal filtration with a frosty touch.
High quality borosilicate glass.
Straight tube.
18mm ground joint.
Inside-cut 18mm > 14mm slitted diffuser.
Colored 14mm herb bowl with handle.
Ideal downstem length: 55cm / 3.3″.
Bullet-hole ice pinch.
